description: Trigger: group_metrics.rs run_group_metrics_sampler() updates per-group gauges each tick but never calls gauge.remove() when a group is GC'd or disappears from the articles table. Bad behavior: stale gauge values for deleted groups persist in the Prometheus metrics endpoint until the daemon is restarted. Operators monitoring group-level article counts will see phantom non-zero values for groups that no longer exist, leading to false alerts.
title: group_metrics sampler retains stale gauge values for GC'd groups indefinitely
